exposure: Fetoscopic selective laser coagulation (FSLC) for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS)
cohort: The study included 138 recipient twins born after twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome treated with prenatal fetoscopic selective laser coagulation.
finding: Four distinct neonatal hemodynamic profiles were identified in recipient twins, with high blood pressure and heart failure (affecting 20% of infants) being associated with a shorter time (less than 2 months) between laser coagulation and birth.
